description: Reads the app's own-database setup. "status": engine in use, migration progress (phase, processed, total, left), its cost so far, quota pause, and writes waiting or set aside; "validate" { engine, config } tests a connection to the developer's database, changing nothing. Never returns credentials. More: neblla_get_llms tools/byodb_read

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

config.description: validate: { uri, dbName? } (mongo), { url, authToken } (turso) or { uri } (postgres, mysql).

env.description: "pro" (the published app, default) or "pre" (the private test copy).

name: neblla_byodb_read
title: Read own database status
